messages.subject: Out of memory error
messages.body_plain:
I am always get a Out of memory error while I was trying to use subread-buildindex to build the index for rat genome from RefSeq.  Here is the information.

Building a base-space index.
Size of memory specified=24000 MB
Base name of the built index = index_chr20
Checking the integrity of provided reference sequences ...
No format issues were found in the input files.
Scanning uninformative subreads in reference sequencing ...
10930 uninformative subreads were found. These subreads will not be included in the index.
Building the index...
Out of memory. If you are using Rsubread in R, please save your working environment and restart R.

However, the program works for very short genome sequence, e.g. Chromosome MT, but doesn't work for large ones. I tried to use -M parameter to enable larger memory, both on my workstation (24G) and the FDA cluster, but it doesn't help.

The rat genome sequences I used were downloaded from http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/assembly/382928/

messages.subject: Re: Out of memory error
messages.body_plain:
Dear Binsheng,

We ran subread-buildindex in v1.3.5-p5 to build an index for rn5 and it completed successfully. So we do not know what caused the failure of your index building. Could you please provide us the full command you used for index building?

Best wishes,

Wei
